author: Temminck & Schlegel, 1848
status: 나그네새 수백 마리 · 겨울철새 수십 마리
habitat: 산지 숲(번식), 평원(월동), 노거수가 우거진 강가 숲
summary: 우리나라에는 해마다 수백 마리가 지나가고 수십 마리가 겨울을 나며, 북부 일부 지역에서는 번식도 한다. 산지의 숲속에서 번식하고 평원에서 겨울을 난다. 여름에는 오래된 큰 나무가 우거진 강가 숲에서 무리 지어 다닌다. 무거운 몸짓으로 힘차게 곧장 날아간다. 우수리, 만주 등지에서 번식하고 만주, 중국 동부 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: very large, deep bill with a curved culmen

points.ko: 폭이 조금 좁은 날개의 흰 무늬

similar.how: 큰부리밀화부리가 몸집이 크고, 특히 부리가 크고 높으며 부리 등이 굽었다. 등은 순잿빛이고 날개의 흰 무늬는 폭이 조금 좁다.

art.subject: Japanese Grosbeak (Eophona personata), adult (sexes alike): glossy blue-black on the forehead, front of the crown, lores, around the eye and on the chin, forming a small black mask; rest of the head, neck, back and underparts plain ash-grey, the back slightly darker grey, the belly and undertail coverts paler whitish-grey; wings glossy black with a small, rather narrow white patch across the middle of the primaries; tail black, notched; huge, deep bill bright waxy yellow throughout, without a dark tip; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched in an old riverside tree, side view
art.scene: Korean summer riverside woodland with old, large trees; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: huge deep yellow bill with a curved culmen, small glossy black mask on the forehead and face, plain grey back and body, black wings with a narrow white patch in the middle of the primaries, black notched tail
adult in flight, seen from below: black wings each with a white patch across the middle of the primaries, grey body, black notched tail, heavy yellow bill; head, body and tail in a straight line
art.build: Large, heavy finch, about 23cm, nearly the length of a starling and clearly larger and bulkier than Hawfinch (Coccothraustes coccothraustes). Large rounded head and thick neck. Bill massive, deep and conical, almost as long as the head, with a curved culmen. Legs short, pinkish. Tail medium length, notched. Flight heavy, strong and direct, the white primary patch showing as a white spot in the middle of the dark wing.
avoid: Do not paint a black tip to the bill, a large black hood or orange-buff flanks — those are Chinese Grosbeak (Eophona migratoria).
Do not paint a brown head and back or a pale wing bar on the coverts — that is Hawfinch (Coccothraustes coccothraustes).
Do not paint white tips on the tertials or primaries; the white is a patch in the middle of the primaries.
Do not make the bill pink, grey or horn-coloured; it is bright yellow.
